goal.title: Verschiebungen zeichnen und verketten
goal.description: Die lernende Person kann dieselbe Verschiebung in der Ebene von einem neuen Ausgangspunkt aus zeichnen und zwei Verschiebungen verketten. Sie begründet den Ergebnispfeil vom ersten Startpunkt zum letzten Endpunkt im Maßstab der Ortszeichnung.
goal.descriptionEn: The learner can draw the same planar displacement from a new starting point, compose two displacements head to tail and justify the resultant from the first starting point to the final endpoint using the scale of the position diagram.

recommendation: Accept only this APV-203 for the named curricular goal and dimension. Keep the declaration at exactly its source-supported states. Its recently reviewed direct mappings substantiate this scope. Ancestor mappings and prerequisite closure are evidence of compiled visibility across sixteen states, not source evidence for a regular target in each state. With the inheritance boundary added only on scratch, partial-mapping diagnostics shrink to the declared states while prerequisite closure still yields sixteen and preserves APV-203. Declaring all sixteen would purport to have 14 additional states without a goal-level witness. The positive targets are exactly the listed authored view memberships. Other stage or jurisdiction contexts rely only on their existing prerequisite paths. The warnings of any other goal stay independently reviewable.
countermodelScope: directOnly adds the existing mapping inheritance boundary on a scratch copy to separate direct from inherited source evidence; it is not an authored catalog change.
